import os,glob,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
for p in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    I=np.array(G[p+' input']); O=np.array(G[p+' output'])
    print(p, 'seeds:', [(r,c,I[r][c]) for r in range(I.shape[0]) for c in range(I.shape[1]) if I[r][c]!=0 and I[r][c]!=3])
    nz=[(r,c,O[r][c]) for r in range(O.shape[0]) for c in range(O.shape[1]) if O[r][c]!=I[r][c]]
    print(' changed cells:', sorted(set(nz)))
    print(' distinct out colors:', sorted(set(O.flatten().tolist())))

import numpy as np, json, os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

import numpy as np
DIRS=((-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1))

def solve(I):
    I=np.array(I); H,W=I.shape; out=I.copy().tolist()
    seeds=[(r,c,int(I[r][c])) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c] not in (0,3)]
    for sr,sc,v in seeds:
        for dr,dc in DIRS:
            r,c=sr+dr,sc+dc
            while 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W:
                nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
                if not(0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W): break
